page.layout: One printed page. Full-width heading at top: running title "EMBLEMA" with heading "NOLI ALTUM SAPERE" below, page number at upper left. Below the heading a framed woodcut engraving (emblem picture, not text). Below the picture, a centred four-line verse in italic. At lower right, a catchword.

l.i: Præcipiti quicunq; gradu tolluntur in altum,
Hi lapsu tantum dein graviore ruent.
Infima qui contra captant, sublimibus ausis:
Hos in fine tamen gloria digna manet.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a cart driven by a woman holding a flag, with figures in fashionable dress being pulled or running beside it, and a banner streaming from a cord. No printed text in the picture. The catchword "Vetustif-" is at the lower right. The verse lines are set in a slanted italic with long s rendered as f in "fublimibus" and "fine"; I have kept the printed s-form as s-equivalent. Line 1 "altum," and line 3 "ausis:" carry printed punctuation as shown.
